_comment: Known dynamic regions of golden-v1047 (measured from two renders of the same app code, 8 Nov 2026): request_detail_*: the 'Submitted' wall-clock time in the mock booking; explore_list_light: the first card's hero photo (network image that loaded in one render and not in the other). Keep masks tiny: they hide regressions inside them. Remove once the harness freezes the clock and preloads images (P2). 8 Nov (gate run 42497373827): the clock text is wider at some times of day than in the golden, so its first digit falls left of the original box; request_detail masks were widened to the left to contain the full text (the measured changed-pixel boxes lay directly left of the old masks, same text line). 8 Nov (gate run 42517685281): tabular digits make the first digit of the time start up to ~18 px left of the golden's ink ('1' vs '2'), and the date part changes at midnight UTC, so request_detail_* now mask the whole value line of the 'Submitted' row (date and time, measured on the golden); the label above it is not masked. Proper fix: freeze the clock in the harness when the golden is re-baselined (P4).
_maps_stub: Listing wizard step 1 and edit listing: the Google Maps SDK draws its own 'ProHost won't run without Google Play services' text when Play services are missing (always the case in Robolectric); its colour differs between Compose versions. It never appears on a device with Play services. Rectangles measured 9 Nov 2026 with a few px slack.
_library_rendering: 9 Nov 2026 (Compose 1.12 / Material 3 1.4): splash = indeterminate spinner phase; explore_map = the Google Maps stub text at the top and the card photos in the bottom strip (image filtering differs by a few levels, visually identical); renting_progress_ar/rtl = the 0 % progress bar's end dot; premium_plans = the renewal date, which moves with the day (golden taken 8 Nov). Remove with the P4 re-baseline (frozen clock, preloaded images).
_scroll_viewport_edges: edit_booking_small / rebook_small: the 18 rows under the scrolled list's top edge and the 45 rows above its bottom edge show different slices of the content because the list sits 4 px lower than in the golden (scroll-to-node rule of the test framework, docs/migration/scroll-offset.json); the rows between must match exactly after shifting.
_version_text: delete_account_small: the profile's update row prints the app version (golden: v1.0.47). The migration test build is 1.0.48; the digit is masked. Remove when the golden is re-baselined at the next version.
